career.layoutCall: 0.686-mile oval: USF Pro 2000 Freedom 90, 25 May 2024 (official results PDF; research notes item 9). OSM's oval line measures 1062 m against the published 1104 m (ovals are usually measured 15 ft off the inside wall, not on the centreline). The July 2026 Formula DRIFT pavement is not part of the oval.
